notes: The macOS guest was addressed by native_macos::fabric over the vsock agent channel, which matches the interface by MAC and applies the IPv4 the fabric plan derived. macOS has no kernel-cmdline hook, and there is deliberately no DHCP, so this is the only channel that exists before a Machine has an address. This is the first successful execution of that path.
All three Machines hold addresses on one derived /24; the target OS is not an input to any address derivation.
